description: This file defines the StreamWrapper class for integrating Amazon S3 storage with PHP's stream API, supporting stream modes 'r', 'w', 'a', and 'x'. It handles opening, reading, writing, seeking, stat, directory listing, and other stream operations specialized for S3 objects, enabling transparent S3 bucket interaction through URLs like s3://bucket/key.

classes.name: Aws\S3\StreamWrapper
classes.description: A PHP stream wrapper class for Amazon S3, enabling file-like access to S3 buckets and objects using s3:// URLs, supporting reading, writing, appending, deleting, listing, and other stream operations with S3 storage.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers the 's3://' stream wrapper with the provided S3 client, setting up default context and cache options.

methods.name: stream_close
methods.description: Closes the stream, flushing if necessary and releasing resources.

methods.name: stream_open
methods.description: Opens a stream for a given s3:// path with specified mode ('r', 'w', 'a', 'x'), preparing internal state for subsequent operations.

methods.name: stream_eof
methods.description: Checks if the end of the stream has been reached.

methods.name: stream_flush
methods.description: Flushes buffered data to S3, handling the upload of the current stream body.

methods.name: stream_read
methods.description: Reads data from the stream.

methods.name: stream_seek
methods.description: Seeks to a position within the stream, if seekable.

methods.name: stream_tell
methods.description: Returns the current position within the stream.

methods.name: stream_write
methods.description: Writes data to the stream buffer.

methods.name: unlink
methods.description: Deletes the specified S3 object.

methods.name: stream_stat
methods.description: Returns standard stat info for the stream.

methods.name: url_stat
methods.description: Performs stat on a s3:// URL, utilizing cache.

methods.name: initProtocol
methods.description: Extracts protocol from the s3 URL.

methods.name: createStat
methods.description: Creates a stat array for a bucket or object, attempting to retrieve metadata from S3.

methods.name: statDirectory
methods.description: Handles stat for directories or buckets.

methods.name: mkdir
methods.description: Creates a new bucket or pseudo-folder.

methods.name: rmdir
methods.description: Deletes a bucket or folder if empty.

methods.name: dir_opendir
methods.description: Opens a directory listing with optional filtering for iteration.

methods.name: dir_closedir
methods.description: Closes directory handle.

methods.name: dir_rewinddir
methods.description: Rewinds directory listing.

methods.name: dir_readdir
methods.description: Reads next entry in directory listing.

methods.name: formatKey
methods.description: Formats an object key as a URL.

methods.name: rename
methods.description: Renames an object within the same bucket.

methods.name: stream_cast
methods.description: Unsupported stream casting.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates stream arguments for opening.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Retrieves options for the current stream context.

methods.name: getOption
methods.description: Retrieves a specific stream context option.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Gets the configured S3 client.

methods.name: getBucketKey
methods.description: Extracts bucket and key from a s3 URL.

methods.name: withPath
methods.description: Combines bucket, key, and context params into a complete array.

methods.name: openReadStream
methods.description: Initiates a GET object request and sets the body for reading.

methods.name: openWriteStream
methods.description: Prepares a temp stream for writing.

methods.name: openAppendStream
methods.description: Fetches existing object for appending or creates a new stream.

methods.name: triggerError
methods.description: Handles error reporting for stream operations.

methods.name: formatUrlStat
methods.description: Creates stat array for a URL, based on S3 object metadata.

methods.name: createBucket
methods.description: Creates a new S3 bucket.

methods.name: createSubfolder
methods.description: Creates a pseudo-folder in a bucket by uploading an empty object.

methods.name: deleteSubfolder
methods.description: Deletes a subfolder if empty.

methods.name: determineAcl
methods.description: Determines appropriate ACL string based on file permissions.

methods.name: getStatTemplate
methods.description: Returns a template array for stat info.

methods.name: boolCall
methods.description: Executes a callable, handling exceptions as errors.

methods.name: getCacheStorage
methods.description: Returns the cache object for stat info.

methods.name: clearCacheKey
methods.description: Removes cached stat info for a specific object.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns size of the current stream body.
